evals.prompt: Implement Reserve and focused tests as described in README.md. Preserve the public API, schema, pinned dependency and Go 1.22 support.
evals.expected_output: Complete baskets participate in one transaction, release resources and preserve results, error causes and persisted invariants.
assertions: Every participating helper uses the active transaction; a one-connection pool remains reusable.
Late statement and deferred constraint failures roll back only this attempt; concurrent pools cannot oversell.
Active driver-call cancellation preserves required context causes; uncertain commit returns no usable receipt and does not replay.

evals.prompt: Implement Materialize and focused tests as described in README.md. Preserve the public API, SQL contracts and Go 1.22 support.
evals.expected_output: Bounded reads finish before dependent transaction work; result and completion errors remain observable.
assertions: Rows close before another operation needs the same connection; Scan, terminal iteration and early close failures survive.
All operations use the transaction, preserve context and release owned resources; commit failure cannot publish a confirmed report.

evals.prompt: Implement Reconcile and focused tests as described in README.md. Preserve the public API, native pgx stack and Go 1.22 support.
evals.expected_output: Owned native pgx transactions finish safely while borrowed Post work and the host pool retain their owners.
assertions: Create, query, post and exact selected-row attachment share one transaction; rows finish before dependent work.
Only successful commit publishes Report; empty runs succeed and original plus required rollback causes remain inspectable.
Canceled callers still receive bounded metadata-preserving cleanup; Post never finalizes a borrowed transaction.

evals.prompt: Implement ApplyAdjustments and focused tests as described in README.md. Preserve the public API, pinned dependencies and Go 1.22 support.
evals.expected_output: A child savepoint isolates this sub-operation and leaves parent finalization to its caller.
assertions: Success remains staged; failure undoes this call while preserving earlier parent work when child rollback succeeds.
Already nested parents work; begin/release/original/rollback errors remain observable.
Cancellation permits bounded metadata-preserving cleanup without a new connection or goroutine; empty input remains a no-op.

evals.prompt: Fix Total as described in README.md, selecting only applicable skills.
evals.expected_output: A direct positive sum preserves the API without database or lifecycle machinery.
assertions: The database skill is skipped for a local calculation.
Only strictly positive values contribute; no dependency, context, transaction or concurrency abstraction is introduced.
